name: Slick mark
description: One mark of Slick Trail, and the only document in the roster drawn to be stamped on itself: the game lays one every fourteen pixels of walking and the mark is forty-four long, so three and a half copies of it overlap everywhere along the ribbon. That is the whole brief. Every edge here therefore fades to nothing instead of ending — no rim, no outline, no bead sitting on the silhouette — because an opaque edge printed every fourteen pixels is a segment boundary, and a run of segment boundaries with bumps down both flanks is a grub with legs. That is what the first draft laid, and ss.fx.acid-jet was redrawn once already to get out of exactly the same reading. Colour is the other half of it: a slick only slows, it does not burn, so it is off the venom ramp altogether and onto cool wet greys no other ground in this game owns — the acid is green, the muck brown, the burst red, the flare orange, and a find that takes nothing off you should not be wearing the colour of the one that does. What is left is what a slick actually is: ground gone dark and glossy, with the light caught along the spine and nowhere else, because the sprite is turned to the heading it was laid on and a highlight on one flank would swing round with it.
